bug_semantics: Generic CRUD add() marshals request body through patchEntity without stripping the primary key. A caller who can POST an add endpoint can therefore set id on a newEmptyEntity (object spoofing / identifier collision). A later guard unsets $params['id'] before __massageInput(), which copies request->getData() into $input, so attacker-supplied id still reaches patchEntity.
flaw_origin: 62c9050fb2c5fb0d351594dec8bbec645860940b first added app/src/Controller/Component/CRUDComponent.php with add() doing patchEntity($data, $this->request->getData()). Parent dccf9d5fd6c1ad13d5983a5c13ef41456551aa71 has no CRUDComponent path. Later a7348e52 extracted __massageInput() still copying getData(); 7159034e added the ineffective unset($params['id']) before massage. Those are not the first write of the sink.
